### Rabbit Slot

> Trigger words: `うさぎ` / `ウサギ` / `ドワーフ` / `rabbit` / `dwarf` / `usagi`

- A slot-style omikuji inspired by Nolimit City's "Fire in the Hole". Compete for the highest score.
- The more rabbits 🐇, the more coins you can hope to win!
	- The more carrots 🥕 appear, the more rabbits tend to show up. Did they hire them?
- Coins 🪙, banknotes 💴, money bags 💰️, diamonds 💎, TNT 🧨, and pickaxes ⛏️ all boost your score!
- The cap is 5,000 coins. Go for the jackpot!
